landing.hero.title: Buy POSX, earn team rewards, claim anytime.
landing.hero.subtitle: Connect your wallet to purchase POSX with USDT. Rewards accrue on a daily settlement cycle. All claims settle on-chain via your signature — we never hold your funds.
landing.trust.no_custody: Self-custody — we never hold your keys
landing.how.title: How it works
landing.how.subtitle: Three steps from connecting your wallet to claiming rewards.
landing.how.step1.title: Connect your wallet
landing.how.step1.body: Sign in with TP Wallet or any EIP-1193 wallet. We request a one-time message signature — no token approvals required at this step.
landing.how.step2.title: Buy POSX with USDT
landing.how.step2.body: Enter the amount you want to purchase, send USDT on-chain, and attach your transaction hash. Orders confirm automatically.
landing.how.step3.title: Earn rewards and claim
landing.how.step3.body: Daily settlement generates direct, team, and equal-level rewards. Claim to your wallet anytime once the minimum is met.
landing.why.title: Why POSX
landing.why.trust.title: Self-custody first
landing.why.trust.body: You keep your keys. POSX never holds user funds — every claim settles via an on-chain signature from your wallet, verifiable on the explorer.
landing.why.settlement.title: Transparent settlement
landing.why.settlement.body: Rewards settle on a published daily cycle. Every epoch is auditable on the block explorer, with a full audit trail in-app.
landing.why.team.title: Team-aware rewards
landing.why.team.body: Direct referral, team, and equal-level bonuses compound as your network grows. Daily breakdowns show exactly where each reward came from.
